request.style: English, Lutheran chorale, a full church congregation singing in unison with a mighty pipe organ, steady even notes, plain and majestic, 4/4, 72 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Our God, our refuge and our strength
A help so near in need
We will not fear though earth gives way
And mountains fall to sea

[Verse]
Though waters roar and foam and rage
And hills shake at the swell
A river gladdens God's own town
Where the Most High will dwell

[Verse]
The nations rage, the kingdoms fall
He lifts his voice, earth melts
Yet God is in her midst, she stands
He helps her when day breaks

[Verse]
The LORD of hosts is here with us
Our fortress, Jacob's God
Be still, and know that I am God
Let all the earth be awed
